labelProvenance: Wikidata taxon names (P225), entity labels and interwiki titles; isolated vernacular names were also cross-checked in linked Commons VN displays. VN may combine Wikidata data with manually entered category names: a Commons URL alone does not establish a P1843 source. No category prose, template code or media is reproduced.
taxonomyNotes: These are species, not breeds or colour mutations. Scientific names and Wikidata identifiers were individually verified.
Taeniopygia castanotis denotes the Australian zebra finch, distinguished from the Sunda zebra finch Taeniopygia guttata.
Serinus canaria is the canary species; the domestic canary form is not entered as a separate species.
Catalogue entries identify existing pets and are not recommendations for wildlife acquisition. This is a curated starter selection, not an exhaustive avian taxonomy.
Cricetulus griseus is retained as the verified source species concept; some classifications use Cricetulus barabensis griseus.
Goldfish varieties are recorded as varieties of Carassius auratus, never as independent species.
